# Stimulus: per channel, xorshift32 (L seed 0x12345678, R seed 0x9E3779B9; s^=s<<13, s^=s>>17, s^=s<<5, then use) top 16 bits as int16 / 32768 for 32000 samples, then ((i*220*65536/32000) mod 65536 - 32768) / 32768 for i in 0..31999 (integer division); all times 0.25.

# Digest: 8 non-overlapping 8000-sample windows from sample 0; rectangular rfft; power |X|^2 * w / 8000^2 (w = 2, 1 at DC and Nyquist) summed over bins f=k*4 Hz with lo <= f < hi; 10*log10, -300 where the sum is under 1e-30.
